meta.title: OG Doc Admin
meta.description: User/role management, object-type editor, registry overview (Admin UI, concept 8)

home.title: OG Doc Admin
home.hint: Select an area from the navigation.

roles.name: Name
roles.pendingApproval: Four-eyes principle active - the new role awaits approval by a second person before it is created.

groups.hint: Complements the system's built-in "everyone" group (every authenticated person) with admin-creatable groups that have a real member list - a role assignment to a group applies to every enrolled member.
groups.name: Name
groups.isOrgUnitHint: Flags this group as an org unit (14.2) - only groups flagged this way count for a dynamic access grant "to the org unit" (four-eyes-style deputization during absence, triggered by workflow-service). Without the flag, no group counts, regardless of membership.
groups.orgUnitToggleError: Failed to change the org-unit flag

orgHierarchy.hint: Assigns one or more supervisors to a person (several are possible, e.g. in matrix organizations). Basis for dynamic access grants and the supervisor overview in one of the next sessions.
orgHierarchy.chainLookupError: Supervisor chain could not be determined
orgHierarchy.chainLookupEmpty: {principalId} has no supervisors (not even indirect ones).

teamspacesAdmin.hint: Installation-wide overview of all teamspaces (2.5) - independent of your own membership. Creating/deleting/member management stays self-service, this is visibility only.
teamspacesAdmin.name: Name

storageOperationalConfig.hint: Operational parameters of the configured target set (3.6) - credentials/target list themselves stay env-var-only, these values take effect immediately, without a restart.

signatureConfig.hint: Signature levels per configured connector (3.10) - the connector list itself stays env-var-only, the levels take effect immediately, without a restart.

approvalSettings.hint: Controls, per action type, whether a second person must confirm the action before it takes effect (4.3). An action type missing from the list is not gated (default behavior).

emailTemplates.hint: Sets its own subject/body template text per use case (and optionally per recipient domain). If no template is configured for a use case, the built-in default text continues to apply unchanged.
emailTemplates.empty: No templates configured yet - the built-in default texts apply.
emailTemplates.subject: Subject
emailTemplates.domainPlaceholder: optional, e.g. example.com - empty = for all domains
emailTemplates.bodyPlaceholder: e.g. Document {title} will be deleted on {retention_until}.

roleAssignments.pendingApproval: Four-eyes principle active - the assignment awaits approval by a second person before it takes effect.

objectTypes.name: Name
objectTypes.kennzeichenFormatHint: Placeholders: {YYYY}/{YY} (year), {MM}/{DD} (month/day), {Laufende_Nummer} (required, reset per year). Leave empty = no automatic file reference number.
objectTypes.classificationLevelHint: Deleted documents of a classified class end up in the structurally separate classified trash (2.5) instead of the regular one, regardless of the specific level.
objectTypes.allowedParentTypesHint: No selection = can be placed anywhere (default).
objectTypes.invalidAttributeName: Every attribute needs a technical name.

layoutDesigner.heading: Form layout designer
layoutDesigner.hint: Adjusts how an object type's attributes are arranged in display, search, and upload (2.2b). Without customization, the automatically generated smart layout applies.
layoutDesigner.emptyLayout: This layout currently contains no fields.

ocrSettings.enabledHint: Whether OCR runs at all is a deployment decision (Docker Compose profile "ocr", see ADR 0016) - only the running service's runtime-adjustable settings are here.
ocrSettings.unreachable: OCR service not reachable - likely disabled via Compose profile (ocrEnabled=false).
ocrSettings.allowedContentTypesHint: Comma-separated, e.g. "application/pdf, image/png" - applies in addition to the technical format check, empty = no restriction (allowlist: only listed content types trigger OCR).

exportSettings.hint: PDF export behavior (history position, ADR 0107) and optional automatic stamping (ADR 0117) - affects document and folder export ("export for filing").
exportSettings.stampEnabledHint: Without activation, the export stays unchanged (default).
exportSettings.stampPositionHint: "Diagonal, centered" is only available for the "Text" stamp type - other combinations are rejected on save.
exportSettings.stampValueTemplateHint: Allowed placeholders: {document_id}, {kennzeichen}. An unknown placeholder is rejected on save.

uploadSettings.hint: The content type is determined server-side from the actual file content (not from the header sent by the browser) and checked against this list (3.1/3.6). Empty = any recognized format is accepted.
uploadSettings.allowedContentTypesHint: Comma-separated, e.g. "application/pdf, text/plain, application/json" - empty = no restriction.

processingFailures.notificationHint: Notifications (email/in-app/webhook) whose automatic delivery has finally failed after several attempts with backoff (Post-Roadmap Phase 20 Session 3, ADR 0079) - a manual restart retries delivery immediately.
processingFailures.renditionHint: Renditions (thumbnails, PDF/A, ...) whose automatic generation has finally failed after several attempts with backoff (Post-Roadmap Phase 20 Session 4, ADR 0080) - a manual restart only retries the affected renderer.
processingFailures.ocrHint: OCR runs that have finally failed after several attempts with backoff (Post-Roadmap Phase 20 Session 4, ADR 0080) - a manual restart retries text recognition immediately.
processingFailures.handoverHint: Handover deliveries between installations that have finally failed after several attempts with backoff (Post-Roadmap Phase 20 Session 5/Phase 40 Session 3, ADR 0081) - either the outbound delivery to the target installation or the return delivery of the result to the sending installation. Loaded DIRECTLY from the federation hub, not via this installation's gateway (the hub is shared infrastructure, not an internal installation component).

delegationsAdmin.hint: Installation-wide overview of all delegations on record (4.4a) - creating one is a self-service feature (User UI), here only an overview + early revocation by an authorized admin role.
delegationsAdmin.filterOrgHierarchyOnly: Show only automatically generated org-hierarchy grants

adGroupMappings.pendingApproval: Four-eyes principle active - the change awaits approval from a second person before it takes effect.
adGroupMappings.mappingsHint: Each AD group on record here automatically grants the mapped role to all of its members (4.4) - multiple rows for the same group are additive (OR).
adGroupMappings.mappingsEmpty: No AD group mappings on record.
adGroupMappings.compositeRulesHint: Several AD groups together (AND, at least two) grant a role jointly - unlike the simple mappings above, where any one alone is enough.
adGroupMappings.compositeRuleNeedsTwoGroups: At least two distinct AD group names are required.
adGroupMappings.defaultRoleHint: Granted when a principal brings AD groups but none of them appear in any mapping/rule above - a single setting, optionally protected by the four-eyes principle (installation-wide configuration).

userTracking.configHint: Fine-grained session tracking (5.5) for privileged accounts - off by default, except for the activated superuser (4.6), who is always tracked regardless of this setting.
userTracking.sessionsHint: Client IP, user agent, and auth method per login/refresh - no GeoIP, no client-side fingerprinting, no stored session duration (deliberate limitation, ADR 0157). Shows the most recent 200 entries.
userTracking.retentionHint: Own, short retention period for tracking data, separate from the regular audit log (5.3).
userTracking.retentionInvalid: Retention period must be at least 1 day.

shareLinkSettings.hint: Installation-wide switch for time-limited, unauthenticated read-access links to individual documents (4.2a). Disabling immediately locks already-issued links too, not just new ones.

retentionSettings.hint: Installation-wide base settings for forced deletion (5.2a) and trash (5.2) - overridable per object type in the object-type editor (deletion reason requirement) or supplemented (default retention period).
retentionSettings.deletionReasonRequired: Require a deletion reason for forced deletion
retentionSettings.deletionReasonCatalogHint: Suggested deletion reasons (selection list in the User UI, in addition to a free-text "Other" field)
retentionSettings.deletionReasonCatalogEmpty: No suggestions yet - only a free-text field is shown.
retentionSettings.foldersHint: Own, independently configurable base settings for folders (since P7-S1b) - an installation operator may need different rules for folders than for documents.

deletionRegister.hint: Every physical deletion (forced deletion or expired trash period, 5.2a) is recorded here - independent of the (still-missing, see Phase 11) separate backup policy, additionally published as a regular audit event. Shows documents and folders (since P7-S1b) together.

archivalTransfers.hint: Every document whose object-type deadline has expired or which was manually triggered for disposal (5.6) goes through a transfer state machine here up to the archive copy (PDF/A) and - after a transition period - removal of the live storage copy ("dehydration"). Metadata and the audit trail always remain findable throughout.
archivalTransfers.requestArchiveSuccess: Document flagged for immediate disposal - picked up on the next run of the disposal service (default: hourly).
archivalTransfers.confirmRetrieve: Retrieve document {documentId} from the archive and restore the live storage copy?
archivalTransfers.caseHint: For closed case binders (2.3), an XDOMEA 4.0.0 disposal message (message type 0503) is generated and packed into a package together with the referenced document contents (5.6). Unlike documents, there is no dehydration and no write-back - a case binder has no live storage space of its own, only a package download.

reports.empty: No data for the selected period/filter.
reports.schedulesHint: Regenerates the selected report on a recurring basis and sends an email with a download link via the notification service (no attachment).

forensicTrace.hint: Object-related tracing (5.4b) — shows every action a person, document, or folder was involved in. Central use case: if an account is suspected of being compromised, trace exactly what that person did. Every query is itself audited again.
forensicTrace.empty: No matches for the selected filters.
forensicTrace.filteredHint: {visible} of {total} events visible (the rest is hidden by your permissions).
forensicTrace.subject: Object

queryConsole.hint: Central query & trace console (6.1) — federated read access to the audit trail. Every query runs under the security context of the executing person: result rows for which there is no read permission on the associated folder are automatically hidden. Every query is itself audited again.
queryConsole.empty: No (visible) matches for the selected filters.
queryConsole.filteredHint: {visible} of {total} events visible (the rest is hidden by your permissions).
queryConsole.subject: Object
queryConsole.manipulationHint: Write queries (6.1, since P8-S2) — a curated catalog of structural actions instead of free-form SQL text. Every action must first be simulated (dry run) before it can be executed; critical actions (permission/role tables, object-type/constraint definitions) always require a second approval, even for the activated superuser.
queryConsole.manipulationValueParseError: New value is not valid JSON.
queryConsole.criticalBadge: Critical action — always requires a second approval.
queryConsole.pendingApprovalResult: Approval request created — a second person must approve it (see table below).

auditTraceSettings.hint: Controls how deeply read access to documents is logged for the forensic trace (5.4b). The base applies to everyone unless one of their roles has an override. On conflicting role overrides, "log" wins.
auditTraceSettings.overridesHint: A role without an override follows the base configuration above.

kennzeichenSettings.hint: Global default for whether an automatically assigned file reference number (2.2) is shown before the filename. Individual document classes can override this default in the object-type editor.
kennzeichenSettings.showBeforeFilename: Show file reference number before filename

configPackages.hint: A configuration package is a curated, versioned configuration document (7.3) - e.g. the eGov configuration package (14.2). Application runs through the existing, secured configuration import (additive/upsert, repeatably applicable). The preview before applying shows what would change without changing anything yet.
configPackages.invalidDocument: Not a valid configuration file (missing or invalid JSON, no 'schema_version' field).
configPackages.noManifest: No manifest - a plain configuration document (7.3) with no name/version/description.
configPackages.pendingApproval: Four-eyes principle active - applying the package awaits approval by a second person before it happens.
configPackages.deltaOnlyInSystem: Only in the current system (stays unchanged)

configCompare.hint: Compares the active installation's configuration (7.3) against another known installation - e.g. for drift detection between staging and production (7.5). Field-level comparison (no deep structural check, ADR 0040) - a change deep inside an object-type layout is reported as 'the entire layout differs', not row-precise.
configCompare.baseIsActive: Base is the active installation ({name}) - its current, live-fetched configuration.
configCompare.noOtherInstallations: No other installation known - add a second installation under "Installation management" first.
configCompare.compareError: Comparison failed - check the other installation's credentials or reachability.

storageGuard.hint: Whether the storage service automatically refuses to start or starts degraded on a detected media change (3.6, ADR 0017). The target set itself (which backends/credentials are configured) is deployment configuration, not editable here - object lock/disposal role per already-configured target have been live-editable since Post-Roadmap Phase 22 Session 7 (ADR 0092), taking effect without a restart.
storageGuard.unreachable: Storage service not reachable - possibly due to a refused start after a detected media change (see server log).
storageGuard.confirmDecommission: Decommission target "{targetId}"? All copy rows for this target will be removed - an object whose only confirmed copy is here blocks decommissioning instead.
storageGuard.allowDegradedStart: Allow degraded start if at least one target is verifiably unchanged
storageGuard.confirmReidentify: Accept the media change for target "{targetId}"? All existing copies on this target will be flagged for re-replication.

superuser.hint: Superuser access is disabled by default (4.6). Activation requires two different people with the "Superuser break-glass release group" role: one requests it, a second approves it.
superuser.requestSent: Approval request created (ID: {id}) - a second person with the release role must approve it.

result.pending_approval: Approval request created - a second person with the "Not-shutdown trigger" role must approve it.

maintenanceBanner.text: System-wide emergency lockdown active - only the activated superuser can act.

license.hint: Install a signed license file and view current usage per dimension (9.1-9.3). An exceeded limit does not block existing data but prevents new creations.
license.bannerNotInstalled: No license installed - restricted operation (demo mode/lock per component).

installations.hint: Each installation is fully isolated (concept 3a) and needs its own login - afterward you can switch between already-logged-in installations without logging in again, as long as the respective session is valid.
installations.name: Name
